log.memory: I am Lucy, a Fenwick of Stannick, wife (partner) of Roger. In-laws Jory (head) and Ellen, who is past bearing. My parents Richard and Avice live at Moor House beside us. Fenwick aim: be the largest family; try with Roger most days (two units on a side seems needed; matching messages can cross, so say the number plainly), keep all fed and warm. State at summer day 5: Fenwick House store ~22 firewood, ~19 grain (13 meals, four eat about 4 a night), ~9 timber, hay. Forage at the Gill and Stannick Moor is picked bare and takes days to return. The Brakes give firewood well (2.5-2.9 a unit). Bare-hand fell gives only ~0.7 timber a unit. Winter wants about 16 timber or 64 firewood per hearth. Harvest: Infield rye is held by the Moors, ripe about summer day 9 or autumn day 1. Richard agreed that Roger and I reap and get a quarter share, same terms as Jory. Be at the Infield at first light when it is ready. I have no tool: try 'make crude tool' (timber plus maybe stone) before harvest, since a copper tool is x1.5 and bare hands only x0.6 for reaping. I weed the Infield for the Moors, which helps the crop and my share. Offer syntax lesson: work offers must be written 'work 2 days', not 'work 2 days reaping'. Goods as '2 bread'. Other: Quarry is near the Moor, and I am competent at quarrying but need a tool. Wynford market is every eighth day, 2 days away. If food runs short, consider game at the Weald or trade at Wynford. Kin elsewhere: Ashe, Rook (Holloway), Wynn, Cotter (Wynford), Reed (Westmere); find partners for grown kin eventually.
